title: High Context — The Full City
description: A playable leaf branch for higher-tier players. Carries the full Saltspire card set. On a Multiple Choice scenario, the leaf branch is where the real plot components and cards live.
prompt: Rain has not stopped over Saltspire in living memory. The city clings to a ring of black basalt sea-stacks, its districts strung together by groaning rope-and-iron bridges. Lantern Guild marshals walk the high spans; the Underkeel Pact works the flooded caverns below. You arrive on the dawn ferry with a soaked letter naming one contact, Old Coromb, who may already be dead.
authorsNote: Tone: harbor noir; rain-soaked and tense.
aiInstructions: You are the storyteller and gamemaster. Write in second person, present tense. Judge > actions for realistic outcomes. Keep the city wet, cramped, and alive. Let danger be quiet and consequences real.
